newsitem.title: UK: Smaller Novorossiisk pipeline reopens after repair.
newsitem.headline: Smaller Novorossiisk pipeline reopens after repair.

text.p: The smaller of two pipelines carrying crude oil to Russia's Black Sea port of Novorossiisk opened late on Thursday after a scheduled maintenance shutdown, a shipping source said.
The pipeline reopened at 2020 local time after closing at 1000 local on Tuesday, pumping at a rate of 900 tonnes per hour.
The main 90,000 tonnes per day pipeline, which was also shut on Tuesday, was due to reopen at 2300 local on Friday, the source said.
Two small crude tankers were alongside berths two and six at Russia's leading export terminal and a third larger vessel was at anchor outside the port.
Operations at other Black Sea and Baltic oil ports were normal on Friday, the source added.
